'''Lex''' develops game plugins for [[TCGMix]], a website for playing card games in a browser.<ref name="plugins" /> Lex announced the project hub on 2 October 2026, with [[Stargate Trading Card Game]] and [[Harry Potter Trading Card Game]] available and [[Young Jedi]] planned.<ref name="hub" />

== TCGMix development ==

On 10 October 2026, Lex announced playtests built with a new plugin system under development. The initial list included [[Star Wars CCG]], [[Star Trek CCG|Star Trek CCG Second Edition]] and several other card games.<ref name="plugins" />

In an 11 October update, Lex described the Star Wars CCG prototype as playable but still rough, with bot opponents, multiplayer, custom decks and a card pool based on Premiere.<ref name="prototype" />
